fixes.name: Vireio Perception
fixes.pros: Open-source stereo + 6DOF headtracking driver. Works across many older DX9/DX11 engines without per-game shader fixes.
fixes.cons: Older driver lineage — modern (DX12) games are out of scope. Some shader effects (specular highlights, bumpmaps) can render at screen depth.
fixes.notes: Creation Engine DX11 path. Disable Skyrim's own borderless windowed mode.
